statement: For which positive integers $n$ does there exist a positive integer $A$ divisible by 2022, using only digits 0 and 7, with exactly $n$ sevens?

Acute $\triangle ABC$ ($AB<AC$); $D$ = foot of bisector from $A$ on $BC$; $E\in BC$ with $AB=AE$; $F\in BC$ with $BD=DF$; $G\in AC$ with $AB=AG$. Prove the circumcircle of $\triangle EFG$ is tangent to line $AC$.
10,000 contestants: the $k$th takes $k/n$ of the remaining cake. Which contestant takes the largest piece?

Alberto places $a_1,\ldots,a_{2022}$ in a $2022\times 2022$ table (cell $(i,j)$ contains $a_{\max(i,j)}$). Barbara wants to determine $a_k$ by asking for sums along paths from top-left to bottom-right. Find the minimum number of questions needed, as a function of $k$.

Robot Mag-o-matic has 101 glasses. An instruction $(a;b,c)$ means: if glass $a$ has a ball, swap glasses $b$ and $c$. A subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,101\}$ is identifiable if a program outputs a ball in glass 1 iff the number of balls is in $S$. (a) Show odd numbers form an identifiable set. (b) Find all identifiable subsets.

Non-equilateral $\triangle ABC$ with circumradius $R$, incenter $I$, incircle tangent to $CA$ at $D$ and $CB$ at $E$. $A_1$ on line $EI$ with $A_1I=R$ and $I$ between $A_1,E$; $B_1$ on line $DI$ with $B_1I=R$ and $I$ between $B_1,D$; $P=AA_1\cap BB_1$. (a) Prove $P$ is on the circumcircle. (b) If $AB=1$ and $P=C$, find the possible perimeters.
